decisions.reason: Full-page placement does not change the existing requirements to preserve aspect ratio and avoid unintended cropping.
Changing chapter-image presentation to full-page does not alter image sources, permitted generation methods, or suitability criteria.
The full-page image-placement decision does not change Chapter 18 subtitle formatting or chapter-heading consistency.
The source Event concerns chapter-image placement and does not entail any change to the separate cover image or cover trim-size requirements.
Chapter-image presentation has no effect on the copyright-page publication attribution.
Full-page chapter-image placement does not change the authoritative manuscript content, accepted passages, tracked edits, or table punctuation.
The chapter-image layout decision does not affect the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the book title.
Although full-page images may influence eventual pagination, the existing requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after fixing the book size remains valid unchanged.
The image-presentation decision does not alter the requested guidance about front matter, back matter, or publication prerequisites.
Full-page chapter illustrations do not change the required back matter or author lines.
The source Event changes chapter-image presentation only; it does not change the paperback format or the already established 6 x 9 inch trim size.
